Swami Rama Himalayan University vs Uttaranchal University is a Dehradun healthcare comparison. The listed programmes are not the same degree, and neither college has a placement or rank row here.

sections.heading: Swami Rama Himalayan University vs Uttaranchal University for Healthcare UG: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Swami Rama Himalayan University if you want a Bachelor of Occupational Therapy or B.Sc. Radiation and Imaging Technology, with recorded year tuition of ₹65,500, after you confirm the official notice.
Choose Uttaranchal University if Bachelor of Optometry is the programme you want, with recorded year tuition of ₹1,09,300, after official confirmation.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what to watch
paragraphs: For Swami Rama Himalayan University we hold year tuition of ₹65,500 for BOT and for B.Sc. Radiation and Imaging Technology. A diploma in dialysis technology is also listed; do not mix that diploma fee, if one appears later, with these undergraduate rows.
For Uttaranchal University we hold year tuition of ₹1,09,300 for B. Optometry. That is a year figure, not a confirmed official programme total.
Confirm the current notices on srhu.edu.in and uttaranchaluniversity.ac.in before you budget.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Neither college has a placement row on this page for the listed healthcare programmes.
Ask both campuses for an official internship or placement note if outcomes are central to your decision. Do not invent a package figure that is not in our table.

sections.heading: Admission, ranks and eligibility
paragraphs: No entrance exam is mapped on this page. Follow each university's official undergraduate admissions process, including any counselling or interview rules.
Our table has no ranking rows for either college in this comparison.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both are recorded in Dehradun, Uttarakhand, as private universities, so a local student can visit them on the same trip.
The programmes differ. Occupational therapy and imaging technology are not the same degree as optometry. Match the course, labs and clinical exposure, not only the city.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick Swami Rama Himalayan University if BOT or radiation and imaging technology is the course you want, after you confirm the official year tuition.
Pick Uttaranchal University if Bachelor of Optometry is the goal, after official fee confirmation.
This is not a like-for-like programme match. Let the exact healthcare degree decide.
